reviews.title: Undercloocking on This CPU and is a 10/10
reviews.comment: I applied undercloocking on This CPU and is a 10/10. It’s fast and high-quality. While it runs hot during demanding tasks can reach 85 Celsius, however you can easily manage the temperatures with high-quality thermal paste and a solid CPU cooler. For basic to moderate workloads, temps stay between 35°C and 70°C. The performance-to-value ratio is excellent. I’m running it on an ASRock Z790 Phantom Gaming motherboard with 32GB of Corsair RAM, a 1TB Lexar M.2 SSD, and a GTX 1080 powered by an EVGA 850W PSU and Thermalright Peerless Assasin. It handles all my needs perfectly. PD: While taking the screenshot, I was running screen recording software and other tools.
